description: Tool to list Display & Video 360 advertiser links on a property. Use when you need to retrieve DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLink resources associated with a Google Analytics property. Results support pagination for large datasets.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinks on a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200; higher values will be coerced to the maximum.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListDisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinks call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided must match the call that provided the page token.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The name of the property to list DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinks under. Format: properties/{property_id} (e.g., properties/1234).
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLinksListRequest

name: list_dv360_ad_links

adsPersonalizationEnabled.description: Enables personalized advertising features with this integration. Defaulted to true if not set.
adsPersonalizationEnabled.title: Ads Personalization Enabled

advertiserDisplayName.description: Output only. The display name of the Display & Video 360 Advertiser.
advertiserDisplayName.title: Advertiser Display Name

advertiserId.description: Immutable. The Display & Video 360 Advertiser's advertiser ID.
advertiserId.title: Advertiser Id

campaignDataSharingEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables the import of campaign data from Display & Video 360 into Google Analytics. Defaulted to true if not set.
campaignDataSharingEnabled.title: Campaign Data Sharing Enabled

costDataSharingEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables the import of cost data. Can only be enabled if campaign data sharing is enabled. Defaulted to true if not set.
costDataSharingEnabled.title: Cost Data Sharing Enabled

name.description: Output only. Resource name for this DisplayVideo360AdvertiserLink. Format: properties/{propertyId}/displayVideo360AdvertiserLinks/{linkId}.
name.title: Name

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving the subsequent page. Omitted if no further pages exist.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
